clue.text: Information provided in attempt to tart up

parts.note: gen is informal British slang for information

indicators.note: in tells us the word for provided goes inside the word for attempt

parts.note: to try is to attempt
if means provided that

explanation.surface: Someone uses information supplied in an effort to smarten something up.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is British slang for information, as in 'get the gen'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentrification smartens up a run-down area, so to gentrify is to give a place a makeover.

clue.text: Select everyone when it's very cold outside, as one can see

parts.note: to opt is to choose or select

indicators.note: outside says the word for very cold sits around the word for everyone

parts.note: icy means very cold
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Picking everybody on a freezing day is presented as an observable fact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when it's' is only a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done optically is done by means of sight, the way one can see.

clue.text: Driver's object in changing clothes

definitions.meaning: a motorist changes ..., so that is what a driver changes

explanation.definitionFit: A car's driver shifts between gears, and outfit or kit is slang for clothing.

clue.text: Unmarried and living together? Holed up, all in white?

definitions.text: Unmarried and living together? Holed up, all in white?

parts.words: Unmarried and living together? Holed up, all in white?
parts.note: read playfully, the phrase splits into 'not wed' and 'in' for a couple living together unmarried, while straight it means trapped indoors by heavy snowfall

explanation.surface: A cohabiting couple stuck indoors under a blanket of snow.
explanation.definitionFit: Being trapped at home by a heavy fall of snow, with everything white outside.

clue.text: Stew Ottoman leader in sea battle

parts.note: a navarin is a French stew of lamb or mutton

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of Ottoman

explanation.surface: An Ottoman commander is stewing in the middle of a naval engagement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' picks O from Ottoman. NAVARINO (1827) was the sea battle in which allied fleets destroyed the Ottoman navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Navarino is the 1827 naval engagement off Greece where the Turkish-Egyptian fleet was destroyed.

clue.text: P in his place was nothing else

indicators.note: else here means otherwise, so the letters of was nothing are to be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Someone says a president, in his own setting, amounted to nothing more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'else' rearranges WAS NOTHING. P throughout the puzzle stands for president; the US capital is the president's place.
explanation.definitionFit: The US capital is where the president lives and works, and is itself named after the first president.

clue.text: See 26
Being Snoopy, don't vocalise?

parts.note: no as a command means don't
to sing is to vocalise

explanation.surface: Being nosy is likened to an instruction not to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: Nosing around means prying, which is what a snoopy person does.

clue.text: Abandon time off

definitions.meaning: to ... something is to abandon it

explanation.definitionFit: To desert a place is to go away from it, and a holiday from work is a period of permitted absence.

clue.text: Shell made one crazy

definitions.meaning: read as two words, the hard outer casing of a nut

explanation.definitionFit: The husk around a nut is its case, and a lunatic is slangily called a nutcase.

clue.text: Face to face with 6's bird

parts.note: 6 in Roman numerals is VI, and the 's adds an S
avis is Latin for bird

explanation.surface: Meeting the bird belonging to the president of 6 down head-on.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' looks like the cross-reference to WASHINGTON, but here it is just the number in Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means opposite or facing someone directly.

clue.text: Cereal assistant to P

definitions.meaning: Condoleezza ... served President George W Bush as security adviser and Secretary of State

explanation.definitionFit: The grain is a staple cereal, and Condoleezza was a senior aide to the president.

clue.text: Drive drone out — must be superseded

indicators.note: out signals the letters of drive drone are knocked out of their order

explanation.surface: A drone is driven off as something replaced and made obsolete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges DRIVE DRONE; 'must be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruling that is overruled or set aside has been displaced by another decision.

clue.text: P's place was Casablanca

definitions.meaning: the official residence of the US president

explanation.definitionFit: The president's official Washington residence, and the Spanish name of the Moroccan city translates to it.

clue.text: Almost complete solver's soiled

indicators.note: almost means the word for complete loses its final letter

parts.note: to fill is to complete a form
thy is the old form of your, the solver's

explanation.surface: A solver's nearly finished grid has got dirty.
explanation.definitionFit: Dirty or covered in grime, as something soiled is.

clue.text: Rude laugh to make Reg sing

indicators.note: to make here means the letters of Reg sing are made into something new

explanation.surface: A cheeky snort intended to provoke Reg into song.
explanation.definitionFit: A snigger is a stifled, disrespectful giggle.

clue.text: Nobility is part of the architect's plan

definitions.meaning: a drawing of one face of a building

explanation.definitionFit: Loftiness of mind is grandeur, and an architect draws the front view of a building as an upright projection.

clue.text: Stumble and disarrange load, having three feet

parts.note: to trip is to stumble

indicators.note: disarrange tells us to scramble the letters of load

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles and drops a load, like a three-legged stand toppling.
explanation.definitionFit: A tripod stands on three legs, so tripodal describes something with three feet.

clue.text: Footwear on your head? A sort of slope, this

parts.note: a slipper is indoor footwear

indicators.note: head means the first letter of your

explanation.surface: Someone wears a slipper on their head, on a dangerous incline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' gives Y; 'on' places it after SLIPPER in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A slippery slope is a proverbial course that leads to ruin, so the word names that kind of incline.

clue.text: Puzzle why the Queen is in the puzzler's poor home

parts.note: the puzzler is the setter, whose belongings are my

indicators.note: is in says the Queen's letters go inside the poor home

parts.note: a sty is a pigsty, a squalid dwelling
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Someone wonders why the monarch is living in the setter's squalid hovel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'why' serves only the surface question; the puzzler is the setter, so the puzzler's is 'my'.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma or riddle is something puzzling and unexplained.

clue.text: River to spring from assistant to P

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
a well is a spring or source of water

explanation.surface: A river flowing from a spring, linked oddly to a presidential aide.
explanation.definitionFit: Colin was Secretary of State under President George W Bush.

clue.text: P with parent turning previously in a trap

indicators.note: previously places the turned parent before the president
turning says the word for parent is read backwards

parts.note: ma is a mother, a parent
P stands throughout for a president, here George W Bush

explanation.surface: A president and his mother turn earlier into a snare.
explanation.walkthrough: P throughout this puzzle stands for the president, George W Bush.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambush is a surprise attack laid as a snare for the unwary.

clue.text: Successfully resist attack by composer

definitions.meaning: Sir Hubert ... composed the hymn tune Jerusalem

explanation.definitionFit: To fend off a blow is to deflect it, and Hubert wrote the music for Jerusalem.

clue.text: Fellow neither at bow nor stern? Easy!

parts.note: midship is the middle of a vessel, away from both ends
man means a fellow

explanation.surface: A chap stationed in the middle of a ship is told to take it easy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Easy' is the hero of Captain Marryat's novel Mr Midshipman Easy, a junior naval officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Marryat's fictional hero Jack Easy is a junior naval officer of that rank.

clue.text: See 1 across
P's retreat from over-theatrical Bible singer

parts.note: camp means exaggeratedly theatrical
King David is traditionally the author of the Psalms

explanation.surface: A president escapes from a hammy biblical performer.
explanation.walkthrough: CAMP DAVID is the US president's country retreat in Maryland.
explanation.definitionFit: The presidential country hideaway in the Maryland hills.

clue.text: See 1
Free without cover

explanation.definitionFit: Released from ties is liberated, and a book with no binding lacks its covers.

clue.text: Run-of-the-mill way round home

indicators.note: round says the word for way surrounds the word for home

parts.note: a route is a way
in means at home

explanation.surface: An ordinary path circling a house.
explanation.walkthrough: IN for 'home' is the sense of being in, at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinary and humdrum, like a regular procedure done without thought.

clue.text: Serious about Len Turner? That's wonderful!

indicators.note: about tells us the word for serious goes around the other piece

parts.note: heavy can mean serious or grave

indicators.note: a turner turns things, so the letters of Len are turned round

explanation.surface: Someone grave discussing a man called Len Turner finds it marvellous.
explanation.walkthrough: Turner looks like a surname paired with Len, but it is the signal to rearrange those three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavenly is used colloquially for delightful or divine.
